logistics.format: Multiple-choice (one best answer), online with virtual proctoring (Kryterion / Webassessor)

recommended_certs.rationale: ベンダ非依存の CIDPRO に対し、Microsoft Entra 寄りの SC-300 を併用して実装側を補完するパターン。
SailPoint の実装系資格と CIDPRO のベンダ中立な体系を組み合わせる IAM エンジニアが多い。

plus.note: IDPro Body of Knowledge is the only community-driven, vendor-neutral IAM curriculum.

minus.note: CIDPRO launched 2022; market awareness still building vs vendor IAM creds.
No CPE/renewal currently required, which limits long-term currency signal.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: A vendor-neutral IAM body of knowledge and role alignment support associate identity knowledge; open entry, multiple-choice assessment and limited market history do not demonstrate professional IAM delivery.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: A broad vendor-neutral IAM body of knowledge and substantial proctored exam support an associate identity-practitioner signal. Zero experience, multiple-choice assessment and limited market awareness constrain professional hiring assurance.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded vendor-neutral IAM body of knowledge supports a coherent practitioner-domain credential. Zero required experience, multiple-choice testing and no continuing-education requirement limit evidence of delivery and currency.
